data.name: Nikolai
data.gender_notes: Nikolai is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Nikolai is recorded in name-lists as “People of the people”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nikolai expresses “People of the people”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikolai total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: נִכֹלָי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'kol' which means 'voice' and 'lai' meaning 'to God'. Thus, Nikolai means 'people of the voice of God' or 'people who belong to God'. It is not a name found in the Hebrew Bible.

in_greek.name: Νικόλαος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Nikolai in Greek is derived from the words 'nikos' meaning 'victory' and 'laos' meaning 'people'. Thus, Nikolai means 'victory of the people'.

in_latin.name: Nicolaus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Nikolai in Latin is a translation of the Greek name 'Nikolaus', which means 'victory of the people'.
